chose: The public site carries no app: every page is static HTML drawn at build time, beside the landing. The résumé reads as HTML at every width, the same reading view the app's phones show, one page a version (/resume/ the default, /resume/<version>/ the rest) with that version's PDF as a download, where the app embedded the PDF on a desktop and switched versions by a button. The authorship record keeps a script, its one: the record comes from the video's link, so it is drawn in the browser, by the record's own component with no router or app around it. A path the site doesn't have answers a static 404 page linking to the front page and the résumé, where the app sent it to the landing.
